preconditions.expression: isinstance(m, str) and 1 <= len(m) <= 100000 and all(c in '#_' for c in m)
preconditions.description: The input m is a string of length between 1 and 100000, consisting only of '#' and '_' characters.

postconditions.expression:
return_value == '-1' or (return_value.count('
') == 1 and return_value.split('
')[0].isdigit() and all(x.isdigit() for x in return_value.split('
')[1].split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or consists of two lines: the first line is a single integer k, and the second line contains k integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(m[i] == '#' for i in range(len(m)) if any(i in range(start, start + int(length)) for start, length in zip(itertools.accumulate([0] + [int(x) + 1 for x in return_value.split('\n')[1].split()[:-1]]), map(int, return_value.split('\n')[1].split()))))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', all '#' characters in the mask m are covered by the intervals defined by the profile p'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(m[i] == '_' or any(i in range(start, start + int(length)) for start, length in zip(itertools.accumulate([0] + [int(x) + 1 for x in return_value.split('\n')[1].split()[:-1]]), map(int, return_value.split('\n')[1].split()))) for i in range(len(m)))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', all positions in the mask m are either '_' or covered by the intervals defined by the profile p'.
